events.title: JetBlue 2261: Boston → Madrid
events.description: Overnight flight. Arrives Madrid Barajas ~11:30 AM Spain time May 27.

events.title: Arrive Madrid Barajas
events.description: Customs and luggage. Cercanías C1 to Chamartín (~25 min) for the 14:30 ZUBYYB train. C1 also goes to Atocha if we end up on the fallback 19:40.

events.title: Train: Madrid → Valencia (PRIMARY · AVE 05140 · ZUBYYB)
events.description: Locator ZUBYYB. Madrid Chamartín-Clara Campoamor → Valencia Joaquín Sorolla. May 27 14:30 → 16:34. AVE 05140, Premium Confort, Coach 1. Lunch (Almuerzo) onboard. Total €437.65. Cancel 4XYBG8 fallback once we're seated.

events.title: Train: Madrid → Valencia (FALLBACK · AVE 05990 · 4XYBG8)
events.description: FALLBACK only. Locator 4XYBG8. Madrid Atocha → Valencia Joaquín Sorolla. May 27 19:40 → 21:40. AVE 05990, Premium Confort, Coach 1. Dinner onboard. Club Lounge from 17:40. Cancel this once we are seated on the 14:30 ZUBYYB primary train.

events.title: 🏖️ Check in: Valencia beach house
events.description: Vrbo HA-7TLM9D. Maria Pilar's beach house. Carrer d'Isabel de Villena 155. Crib confirmed for Harlan. 3-5 min walk to Malvarrosa beach.

events.title: Deadline: Valencia police guest form
events.description: Required by Spanish law before arrival. Form: heavenonearth.es/docpolicial/indexen.php?id=MTEwOTI=

events.title: Paella lunch — Restaurante Casa Carmela
events.description: Booked for 1:00 PM Spain time. Carrer d'Isabel de Villena, 155.

events.title: Leave Valencia (early checkout / bag hold)
events.description: Vrbo checkout is 11:00 but train is 09:06. Leave ~07:45; ask host Maria Pilar to hold bags or confirm early checkout.

events.title: Train: Valencia → Barcelona (Euromed 01092)
events.description: Locator 9D2RJU. Valencia Estació del Nord → Barcelona-Sants. May 29 09:06. Euromed 01092, Premium, Coach 13.

events.title: 🏨 Check in: Williams Barcelona apartment
events.description: Vrbo 726EF3C0B8 — Luxury Apartment on Carrer de València (between Passeig de Gràcia and Rambla de Catalunya). 5 guests (Williams family).

events.title: Welcome party (Joe & Nikki)
events.description: Fri May 29 at 7:00 PM. Alaire Rooftop. Map: https://tmg.link/app/r/condes — Smart casual.

events.title: Morning Tour · Group A: La Pedrera & Sagrada Família
events.description: Nikki & Joe wedding tour. Meet outside La Pedrera, Passeig de Gràcia 92. Map: https://tmg.link/app/r/lapedrera — Registered: Chandler, Angela, Carson, Elise, Harrison (5 guests).

events.title: Sagrada Família entry
events.description: Locator 97232969. Entry C/ Marina. Sagrada Família Oficial app + photo ID required.

events.title: Evening Tapas Tour (Nikki & Joe)
events.description: Meet outside Catedral de Barcelona. Map: https://tmg.link/app/r/catedralbcn — Questions: joeking7@gmail.com

events.title: Wedding shuttles (pickup)
events.description: Shuttles depart 4:30 PM. Pickup map: https://tmg.link/app/r/shuttlepickup — Wedding party may meet earlier (~2:30 PM) for photos.

events.title: Wedding ceremony & reception
events.description: Main wedding day. Forecast ~77°F (25°C) at ceremony, cooling to ~70°F (21°C) by midnight. Black formal attire. Ceremony start time approximate after 4:30 PM shuttles.

events.title: Check out: Barcelona apartments
events.description: Drop bags at Barcelona-Sants consigna ~12:30 PM, then lunch nearby or in Sants food court until train.

events.title: Train: Barcelona → Madrid (AVE 03152)
events.description: Locator JKSS7B. Barcelona-Sants → Madrid Atocha. Jun 1 15:00. AVE 03152, Premium, Coach 1.

events.title: 🏨 Arrive Madrid Airbnb
events.description: Airbnb HMR8NYWPZF. Host Elena. Calle de la Encomienda 11, La Latina. Smart lock check-in. Crib confirmed for Harlan. All 9 guests.

events.title: Thomas family departs Madrid
events.description: DL0063 Madrid → Boston. Taxi ~12:00–12:30 PM from Airbnb.

events.title: Check out: Madrid Airbnb
events.description: Store bags via Stasher La Latina/Sol or Airbnb partner storage before flight.

events.title: Williams family departs Madrid
events.description: JetBlue 2260 Madrid → Boston. Taxi ~12:00–12:15 PM from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: L'Oceanogràfic (aquarium)
suggestions.description: Europe's largest aquarium. Host Maria Pilar offers discounted skip-the-line tickets.

suggestions.title: Mercado Central
suggestions.description: Open Mon–Sat 7:30 AM–3:00 PM. Great for May 28 flexible morning.

suggestions.title: Malvarrosa Beach
suggestions.description: 3–5 min walk from beach house. Pool at house too.

suggestions.title: Park Güell
suggestions.description: Timed entry required. Book at parkguell.barcelona.

suggestions.title: Gothic Quarter walk
suggestions.description: Wedding venue area. Explore between check-in and 7 PM welcome party.

suggestions.title: Retiro Park
suggestions.description: Rowboats, Crystal Palace. Good post-wedding relax day.

suggestions.title: Prado Museum
suggestions.description: Free 6–8 PM Mon–Sat. Book ahead for daytime visit.

suggestions.title: La Latina tapas crawl
suggestions.description: Walking distance from Airbnb. Cava Baja street.

suggestions.title: 🏨 Thomas + Valerie Barcelona apartment (Ghost)
suggestions.description: VRBO 4156885ha. Quiet 2-bed 2-bath near Ronda de la Universitat & C. de Gravina. 10–15 min walk to Williams apartment. Annalise, Brandon, Harlan, Valerie.

suggestions.title: 🚄 Madrid Chamartín-Clara Campoamor station
suggestions.description: PRIMARY 14:30 AVE ZUBYYB departs here. Cercanías C1 from Barajas T4 (~25 min). Premium Club Lounge access 1 hr before.

suggestions.title: 🚄 Madrid Atocha-Almudena Grandes station
suggestions.description: Arrival from Barcelona (Jun 1, 18:17) AND fallback 19:40 AVE 4XYBG8 to Valencia. Famous tropical garden in main hall. Cercanías hub.

suggestions.title: ✈️ Madrid Barajas T4S
suggestions.description: Satellite terminal for JetBlue and Delta. People-mover to T4 main for passport e-gates. Cercanías C1 downstairs in T4 main.

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Tirso de Molina (L1)
suggestions.description: Closest metro to Airbnb — 2 min walk. L1 (blue) direct to Atocha and Sol.

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro La Latina (L5)
suggestions.description: 3 min walk from Airbnb. L5 (green) direct to Madrid Río riverfront.

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Sol (L1/L2/L3)
suggestions.description: Madrid's central transit hub. 8 min walk from Airbnb. Three lines meet here.

suggestions.title: Plaza Mayor
suggestions.description: Madrid's historic main square. 7 min walk from Airbnb. Street performers, churros, bocadillos de calamares.

suggestions.title: Mercado de San Miguel
suggestions.description: Gourmet food market — graze through stalls. 10 min walk from Airbnb. Best for lunch, touristy but delicious.

suggestions.title: Royal Palace of Madrid
suggestions.description: Spain's official royal residence (ceremonial). Tour ~€13. Bigger than Versailles. 15 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: Chocolatería San Ginés (24 hrs!)
suggestions.description: Open 24 hours. Churros con chocolate at any hour — 1894 institution. 8 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: Sobrino de Botín (world's oldest restaurant, 1725)
suggestions.description: Guinness-record oldest continuously operating restaurant. Roast suckling pig is the move. Book days ahead. 10 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: La Venencia (sherry bar, no photos)
suggestions.description: Time-capsule sherry bar from the Civil War era. No photos, tab written in chalk. 12 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: Casa Alberto (since 1827)
suggestions.description: Vermouth + croquettes. Cervantes allegedly wrote here. Old Madrid soul. 12 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: Juana la Loca (legendary tortilla)
suggestions.description: Runny-center Spanish tortilla — Madrid's best. Standing at the bar. 6 min walk from Airbnb.

suggestions.title: Casa Lucas (huevos rotos)
suggestions.description: Broken eggs over jamón and potatoes. Simple, perfect. 4 min walk from Airbnb on Cava Baja.

suggestions.title: 🚄 Barcelona-Sants station
suggestions.description: All AVE/Euromed in/out here. Consigna (lockers) in main hall ~€10/large bag. Premium Club Lounge access 1 hr before AVE. Food court + La Rotonda upstairs.

suggestions.title: ✈️ Barcelona El Prat (BCN)
suggestions.description: Thomas family lands here May 27 morning (T1). Aerobús A1 to Plaça de Catalunya €7.25. Renfe R2 Nord to Sants €4.60 (T2 platform — free shuttle).

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Passeig de Gràcia (L2/L3/L4)
suggestions.description: 5 min walk from Williams apartment. Three lines = goes everywhere. Direct to Sagrada Família (L2) and Sants (L3).

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Diagonal (L3/L5)
suggestions.description: 5 min walk from Williams apartment. L3 to Sants, L5 north for Park Güell area.

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Universitat (L1/L2)
suggestions.description: 3 min walk from Thomas apartment. L1 to airport (R2 Nord transfer), L2 to Sagrada Família.

suggestions.title: 🚇 Metro Catalunya / Plaça de Catalunya (L1/L3)
suggestions.description: 3 min walk from Thomas apt. Family meeting point. Aerobús A1 from airport arrives here.

suggestions.title: Casa Batlló (Gaudí, more impressive than La Pedrera)
suggestions.description: €35/person, 1–1.5 hr. 5 min walk from Williams apartment. Skip La Pedrera (you'll see it Sat with the tour) — Casa Batlló's interior is the wow.

suggestions.title: La Boqueria food market
suggestions.description: Famous market on La Rambla. 15 min walk from Williams. Best early — touristy by midday.

suggestions.title: Plaça Reial
suggestions.description: Gaudí lamp posts, palm trees, central Gothic Quarter plaza. Great evening hangout.

suggestions.title: Barceloneta Beach
suggestions.description: City beach. 25 min walk or 15 min metro from apartments. Water ~18–20°C late May. Seafood restaurants on the promenade.

suggestions.title: Cervecería Catalana (best tapas in Eixample)
suggestions.description: Walk to it — 4 min from Williams apartment. Expect a line. Order at the bar.

suggestions.title: Tapas 24 (Carles Abellan)
suggestions.description: Celebrity chef tapas. Bikini truffle sandwich + McFoie burger. 3 min walk from Williams apartment.

suggestions.title: Can Paixano (cava bar)
suggestions.description: Standing-room cava + cured meats. €15–20. Locals crushing glasses at noon.

suggestions.title: El Xampanyet (since 1929)
suggestions.description: Unchanged since 1929. Blue tiles, no menu, point at what looks good. Near El Born.

suggestions.title: Bunkers del Carmel (sunset view)
suggestions.description: Civil War anti-aircraft bunkers turned panoramic viewpoint. 360° city view at sunset. Hike ~15 min uphill from Metro El Coll.

suggestions.title: Palau Blaugrana (FC Barcelona roller hockey)
suggestions.description: For Harrison — FC Barcelona's roller hockey arena, sister to Camp Nou. Off-season tours possible. See Family Fun tab.

suggestions.title: Camp Nou immersive tour (Spotify Camp Nou under renovation)
suggestions.description: Stadium closed for renovation; immersive AR tour available nearby. For Elise's soccer fandom.

suggestions.title: 🚄 Valencia Joaquín Sorolla station (AVE)
suggestions.description: AVE arrival from Madrid May 27. ⚠️ DIFFERENT from Estació del Nord — 10 min apart by taxi. Tram L1 to centro from here.

suggestions.title: 🚄 Valencia Estació del Nord (Euromed)
suggestions.description: Euromed departure May 29 09:06. Beautiful Modernista building (1917). ⚠️ NOT Joaquín Sorolla — show up here on the 29th.

suggestions.title: 🚋 Tram Marina Reial Joan Carles I (L4/L6)
suggestions.description: Closest tram to beach house — 3–5 min walk. L4/L6 to centro (~25 min). Taxi (€10–15) usually easier with kids.

suggestions.title: Turia Gardens (former riverbed park)
suggestions.description: 9 km park in the old Turia riverbed. Playgrounds, jogging path, Gulliver Park giant playground for Elise. Free. Connects to City of Arts.

suggestions.title: La Pepica (Hemingway's paella spot)
suggestions.description: Historic beachfront paella since 1898. Hemingway, Orson Welles, Sofia Loren ate here. 10 min walk from beach house. Touristy but legit.

suggestions.title: Albufera Natural Park (rice paddies + sunset)
suggestions.description: Where Valencian paella was born. Boat trip through the rice paddy lagoon at sunset. 20 min taxi south of Valencia. Half-day.

suggestions.title: Mestalla Stadium (Valencia CF) — for Elise
suggestions.description: Valencia CF home stadium. Tours during off-season. Final La Liga match was May 24 — see Family Fun tab.

luggageGaps.recommendation: No storage needed. Cercanías C1 direct Barajas → Chamartín; all 8 bags onboard AVE Coach 1 racks. Use Chamartín Premium lounge for the 1-hour buffer.
Atocha consigna ~€6/bag × 8 = ~€48 for the day (main hall side wing). Keep one carry-on with passports/chargers/kids essentials. Lunch + Retiro + Reina Sofía + tropical garden turtles.

Pre-arrange with Maria Pilar by Wed evening: confirmed early checkout, OR she holds bags on property until 7:45 handoff. Test the WhatsApp the day before. Stasher near Estació del Nord (~5 min walk, €5/bag/day) as backup.

Take all bags in 2 Ubers XL straight to Williams apartment on Carrer de València. Ring host — most VRBO Eixample hosts allow bag drop 1-2 hr early in entryway. Walk to lunch hands-free. Backup: Barcelona-Sants consigna (€10/bag, adds 15 min taxi back).

All 8 bags to Barcelona-Sants in 2 Ubers XL ~12:30 PM and use Sants consigna for ~2 hours (~€48 for 8 bags) OR sit in Sants café area free. Lunch at Sants food court or La Rotonda upstairs. Avoid downtown round trips.

Corpus Christi public holiday — many shops + Stasher partners closed. Best plan: 2 Uber XL direct to Barajas at 10:45 AM. Eat breakfast at airport (T4S has lounges + decent food). Atocha consigna is open year-round if we need to linger; Airbnb partner storage (15% off) may also be open — host Elena can confirm.

items.title: Rodalies (Catalan commuter rail) strike May 27 + Jun 5: CALLED OFF
items.details: CCOO/UGT cancelled the May 27 and June 5 partial strikes after reaching an agreement with Renfe. Thomas family R2 Nord airport→Sants ride May 27 is now clear.

items.title: Valencia teachers' indefinite strike continues (3rd week)
items.details: Daily protests at Conselleria de Educación; 30,000+ at Saturday May 23 march. Beach house unaffected. Avoid central Plaza de la Virgen/government building corridor Thu May 28 if heading downtown.

items.title: Sagrada Família blockade risk during teacher strikes
items.details: Teachers blocked Sagrada Família for 2 hours on May 18 in a previous strike action. Our entry is May 30 at 12:15 PM. Build buffer; Plan B is Casa Batlló (5 min from apartment).

items.title: Tast a la Rambla food festival
items.details: May 28–31 at Plaça de Catalunya. Top Barcelona restaurants serving tasting plates outdoor. Great post-arrival lunch idea Fri May 29.

items.title: Fira Modernista — Modernist Fair
items.details: May 29–31 in Eixample (literally our block). Open houses, workshops, performances tied to Gaudí/Domènech era. Free walking activity.

items.title: NAUKAS Barcelona 2026 — science festival
items.details: Sat May 30 10:45 AM at CosmoCaixa. Theme: 'Ciencia para salvar el mundo'. Conflicts with morning wedding tour for tour-goers but Valerie/Thomas family could attend.

items.title: Anti-Sánchez 'Marcha por la Dignidad' climate
items.details: May 23 march drew 40,000–80,000 protesters Plaza de Colón → Moncloa, with police clashes. PP/Vox-aligned. More demos likely while we're in Madrid Jun 1–4. Typical route: Castellana corridor or Sol/Cibeles. Monitor news each evening.

items.title: Corpus Christi public holiday
items.details: National Catholic feast. Public holiday in Madrid + Castile. Banks + many shops closed. Religious processions near Almudena Cathedral. Williams departure day — eat lunch early; confirm taxi Wed night; Atocha consigna stays open.

items.title: La Liga 2025–26 season ended May 23
items.details: No live league matches during the trip. Bernabéu Tour open all 4 Madrid days. Camp Nou still under renovation through late 2026 — only Immersive Tour + Construction Viewpoint open.
